name: AmenTime
description: Tempo-synced amen-style break slicer for NTS-3. Ships a synthesized 1-bar break (not the Winstons recording). For an arbitrary WAV, use WavSlice. Hold the pad to run. X = start 16th. Y = slice grid (1/4, 1/8, 1/16, 1/32). TUNE adds jungle pitch on top of tempo. RPT LOCK retriggers the start slice. REVS = reverse chance. HOLD GATE or LATCH.

params.name: STRT
params.detail: Which 16th of the bar to start from

params.name: SIZE
params.detail: Slice length: 1/4, 1/8, 1/16, 1/32 of a bar, tempo-synced

params.name: TUNE
params.detail: Extra pitch around tempo-locked playback (±1 octave)

params.name: RPT
params.detail: RUN walks through slices. LOCK retriggers the start slice

params.name: HOLD
params.detail: GATE = hold to play. LATC keeps running after release
